description: Record a custody event on a shipment: pickup, checkpoint, handoff, delivered, exception or note. Pass the chip `uid` (and `signature`) read at the handoff and Aeroz verifies it on the spot, turning a signature on a form into proof of presence. On a high_value lane a handoff without a verified chip raises a finding, and so does a chip that is not among the shipment's items (even an authentic one: `verify_result` is then uid_not_in_shipment; `chip_verify_result` is the chip's own verdict). `pickup` moves the shipment to in_transit and must come before `delivered` (logged telemetry also counts as departure), and `delivered` closes it. A delivered or cancelled shipment is final: it accepts only `note` events.
name: record_custody
title: Record custody
